label: The Solo Overture

floors.notes: THE SOLOIST TAKES THE STAGE. Carlotta walks in alone, three crests, no accompaniment — and only spends her own vigor doing it.
Third solo floor, third perfect. The bench hasn't moved. Six vigor total for nine crests.
FIFTY-EIGHT SECONDS. The all-Havoc echo core met a Havoc-shred interference and deleted a Lv90 double boss with 4:02 still on a 5:00 clock — the third crest only asked for 3:00.
THE HUNT OPENS ALONE. Lupa takes the first floor solo — the Echoing recital begins.
One floor, one flame. ChangLi's solo cameo keeps the streak perfect.

FIFTY-FIVE SECONDS, ALONE. The interference's Intro Skill rider is dead weight for a soloist — Cartethyia took only the Aero shred and still out-timed Resonant's full trio against a Lv90 Lampylumen Myriad.

THE LV100 GAUNTLET OPENS. The Tune Rupture engine walks into an interference built for it — Fusion/Spectro shred, +30% DMG, and a Tunability-Shifting ATK rider — and takes all three crests off the Aero ape.

floors.boss: Violet-Feathered Heron + Vitreum Dancer + Nameless Explorer
floors.notes: TRIPLE THREAT, SAME ENGINE. Three Lv100 bosses share one floor and the Tune Rupture core doesn't blink — perfect crests, back to back.

lessons: Solo clears are vigor arbitrage: Carlotta's F1-3 recital cost 6 vigor from ONE pool instead of ~18 across three resonators — the whole roster walks into Echoing and Hazard Tower untouched.
Match the core to the Interference, not the habit: Havoc RES shred + basic-attack stacking pointed at the Phrolova/Cantarella/Roccia engine and it cashed out at 12/12.
Echoing went 12/12 on four SOLO runs — Lupa, ChangLi, and Cartethyia spent 10 vigor combined, so the entire roster reaches Hazard Tower's Lv100 floors fresh.
Intro-Skill interference riders are dead for soloists (no swap, no Intro) — price a solo run on the flat modifiers only. Cartethyia's 55s says the flat shred can be enough.
Since this rotation, Resonant/Echoing F1-3 clears PERSIST — only each tower's F4 and all of Hazard Tower re-earn. The recurring chase is 18 crests, not 36.
